jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Compa

Compa is a venture-backed AI startup revolutionizing the future of compensation! We're bringing AI-forward tools and human-centered engineering to make pay competitive and fair, for all. By offering a premier, live compensation data platform that delivers top-tier intelligence to enterprise teams, we enable the world's largest companies to make smart and fair decisions while staying competitive and compliant. In dynamic job markets during the rise of AI, companies need the best data to stay competitive!

Our force-multiplying team is powered by live data and thoughtful design, and our products have earned the trust of the world’s largest companies: NVIDIA, Stripe, DoorDash, OpenAI, Moderna, Workday, Ulta, Target, and more.

Come build with us!

The Role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Compa, you’ll own the full sales cycle for our most sophisticated prospects, landing the world’s largest companies on the value of live compensation market data, then consult on expanding the teams that are ready to dive into our AI Agents.

You’ll sell into skeptical, data-driven compensation and total rewards leaders who expect you to earn their trust through genuine partnership. This role reports into the Head of Sales where you’ll be a force multiplier on a lean, high-output team; running your own meetings, building your own pipeline, and partnering with Marketing, Partnerships, and Pre-Sales Insights to get deals across the line.

Tech Stack

HubSpot · Sybill · Clay · Notion

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle end to end.

  • Build consistent, self-generated pipeline through creative, multi-channel prospecting; you don’t wait to be fed leads.

  • Run sharp discovery that surfaces the real compensation and data pain and quantifies what it costs the business.

  • Qualify rigorously: name the economic buyer, put a number on the pain, and confirm a clear path to purchase.

  • Deliver compelling demos that connect Compa’s live data to each buyer’s specific use cases.

  • Partner with Marketing, Partnerships, and Insights to build pipeline and close deals.

  • Write effective, on-brand outbound that earns replies from busy executive buyers.

  • Keep HubSpot current and forecast your business accurately.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience selling technology into large mid-market or enterprise accounts.

  • A track record of building your own pipeline.

  • The ability to run your own meetings and earn the trust of skeptical, data-driven expert buyers.

  • Strong discovery and qualification instincts.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including confident live demo delivery.

  • Comfort operating in a startup environment with lean resources.

As a Plus

  • Experience selling HR tech at a startup.

  • A background selling innovative or category-creating solution.

  • Experience helping first-time or hesitant software buyers.

Compa offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, PTO and parental leave, equity, company offsites, continuous education, commuter benefits and a flexible work environment.

jobs.title: VP of Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Compa

Compa is a venture-backed AI startup revolutionizing the future of compensation! We're bringing AI-forward tools and human-centered engineering to make pay competitive and fair, for all. By offering a premier, live compensation data platform that delivers top-tier intelligence to enterprise teams, we enable the world's largest companies to make smart and fair decisions while staying competitive and compliant. In dynamic job markets during the rise of AI, companies need the best data to stay competitive!

Our force-multiplying team is powered by live data and thoughtful design, and our products have earned the trust of the world’s largest companies: NVIDIA, Stripe, DoorDash, OpenAI, Moderna, Workday, Ulta, Target, and more.

Come build with us!

The Role

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on VP, Finance to join our leadership team at a pivotal stage of growth. As a venture-backed Series B company, we are scaling rapidly — expanding our team, refining our go-to-market engine, and building operational foundations for long-term success.

The VP, Finance will serve as both a strategic thought partner to the CEO and executive team, as well as architect of a world-class finance organization. This is an ideal role for a finance leader looking to build a scalable finance function and grow into a CFO-level position as the business scales.

What You'll Do

Executive Leadership & Strategic Partnership

  • Shape company strategy through a financial lens alongside the CEO and executive team

  • Drive data-informed decision-making across Product, Engineering, GTM, People, and Operations teams

  • Translate complex financial data into clear insights guiding investment, headcount, pricing, and resource allocation

  • Own financial readouts to board and investors

Financial Planning & Capital Strategy

  • Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario planning

  • Develop financial models supporting growth initiatives, M&A evaluation, and capital allocation

  • Partner with CEO on fundraising strategy and investor diligence

  • Monitor key financial metrics (ARR, CAC, LTV, burn, Magic Number, Credit Burndown) for sustainable scaling

  • Manage treasury function, banking relationships, and working capital optimization

Build & Scale the Finance Organization

  • Recruit and develop a top-tier finance and accounting team

  • Design organizational structure that scales with company growth and complexity

  • Develop future finance leaders and foster culture of continuous learning

Finance Systems, Processes & Infrastructure

  • Design and implement scalable financial systems, reporting tools, and processes for Series B+ environments

  • Drive automation and operational efficiencies across billing, revenue recognition, reporting, and planning

  • Build data governance and integrate finance systems with company-wide infrastructure

  • Establish internal controls and compliance frameworks for Series C, international expansion, and IPO readiness

Accounting, Risk & Governance

  • Oversee all accounting operations: general ledger, revenue recognition, AP/AR, payroll, and close processes

  • Ensure accurate, timely financial reporting in accordance with GAAP

  • Develop enterprise risk management framework and governance structures

  • Manage audit processes and external accounting relationships

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, with significant time in venture-backed, high-growth startups (Series A–C preferred)

  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing finance and accounting teams with career development pathways

  • Deep expertise in financial planning, forecasting, and growth modeling in scaling companies

  • Strong understanding of AI credits-based and recurring revenue business models and unit economics

  • Experience partnering with executive teams, presenting to boards and investors

  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement scalable financial systems, processes, and infrastructure

  • Strong accounting foundation with expertise in revenue recognition, internal controls, and financial operations

  • Highly analytical with ability to simplify complexity, influence cross-functional teams, and communicate to non-financial audiences

  • Hands-on, low-ego leader comfortable operating strategically and tactically with genuine interest in developing others

As a Plus

  • Experience leading finance through Series C or later-stage fundraising

  • Banking relationship management and treasury function experience

  • Exposure to IPO readiness, SEC reporting, or international finance operations

  • Familiarity with modern fintech solutions, data analytics platforms, and RPA/automation in finance

  • CPA and/or MBA highly preferred

Compa offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, PTO and parental leave, equity, company offsites, continuous education, commuter benefits and a flexible work environment.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Success
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Compa

Compa is a venture-backed AI startup revolutionizing the future of compensation! We're bringing AI-forward tools and human-centered engineering to make pay competitive and fair, for all. By offering a premier, live compensation data platform that delivers top-tier intelligence to enterprise teams, we enable the world's largest companies to make smart and fair decisions while staying competitive and compliant. In dynamic job markets during the rise of AI, companies need the best data to stay competitive!

Our force-multiplying team is powered by live data and thoughtful design, and our products have earned the trust of the world’s largest companies: NVIDIA, Stripe, DoorDash, OpenAI, Moderna, Workday, Ulta, Target, and more.

Come build with us!

The Role

As Director of Customer Success, you’ll build and lead the team that helps Compa’s enterprise customers get lasting value from our platform. You’ll set the strategy for how we support, retain, and grow some of the world’s largest companies, using data, AI, and automation to deliver a high-touch experience at scale. You’ll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Product, and our compensation experts. You will report to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO).

What You’ll Do

  • Design the CS operating mode: customer segmentation, coverage model, roles, and the handoffs between Sales, Onboarding, and CS

  • Own the net revenue retention, gross retention, adoption, and expansion outcomes, and report on them to executive leadership

  • Define how we measure efficiency (e.g., ARR per CSM, accounts per CSM, cost to serve) and set targets for improving it as we grow

  • Build relationships with senior leaders at key enterprise and Fortune 500 accounts

AI and automation

  • Design an AI first CS motion: automate routine work like health scoring, renewal prep, QBR prep, and customer communications, so CSMs spend their time on high-value strategic engagement

  • Select, implement, and own our CS tooling stack, and build or commission the workflows and agents that surface risk and opportunity early

  • Make “can this be automated or AI-assisted first?” the default question before any new hire request

Team

  • Hire, coach, and develop CSMs, and set the standard for what great looks like at Compa

  • Stay hands-on: act as a player-coach on escalations and key executive relationships, especially in the early stages

Customers and cross-functional partnership

  • Build playbooks for onboarding handoff, adoption, renewals, risk, and expansion, then keep refining them with data

  • Work with our compensation experts to deliver strategic guidance and value to customers

  • Turn customer feedback and usage data into clear Product roadmap input

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in customer success, including 3+ years in a management role

  • Experience in a SaaS or AI technology company

  • Experience working with enterprise and Fortune 500 customers

  • Experience using AI and automation to drive efficiency and improve customer success outcomes

  • Experience hiring, developing, and scaling a customer success team

  • Experience handling customer escalations

  • Experience building and implementing customer success playbooks

  • A data-informed approach to decision-making

As a Plus

  • Experience in a startup environment

  • Experience with compensation, HR tech, or data-driven products

  • Hands-on experience with customer success platforms and AI-enabled CS tooling

Compa offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, PTO and parental leave, equity, company offsites, continuous education, commuter benefits and a flexible work environment.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Compa

Compa is a venture-backed AI startup revolutionizing the future of compensation! We're bringing AI-forward tools and human-centered engineering to make pay competitive and fair, for all. By offering a premier, live compensation data platform that delivers top-tier intelligence to enterprise teams, we enable the world's largest companies to make smart and fair decisions while staying competitive and compliant. In dynamic job markets during the rise of AI, companies need the best data to stay competitive!

Our force-multiplying team is powered by live data and thoughtful design, and our products have earned the trust of the world’s largest companies: NVIDIA, Stripe, DoorDash, OpenAI, Moderna, Workday, Ulta, Target, and more.

Come build with us!

The Role

Compa is an AI-first company, and we hold our own AI adoption to the same security bar our enterprise customers hold us to. Teams across Compa are putting agents and AI tools to work, and doing that securely at enterprise scale is frontier work: the industry playbook is still being written, and we're looking for a Staff Security Engineer who wants to help write it.

As a senior member of Compa's Security team reporting directly to the Head of Security and IT, you’ll build the systems that deliver secure, governed AI to the business: the identity, access, data, endpoint, and network foundation that lets people and agents work safely. Most of your near- and mid-term work is building that foundation. Because it's built from enterprise security primitives, that same work also strengthens and extends our broader security program.

You're a security engineer first. You reason about threats, identity, and trust boundaries before tools, hold a high bar for security and privacy, and measure success by what ships. You're also an enabler: you obsess over getting every piece to line up so that what's secure is also what's easiest to use. Strong pushback is expected where it's warranted; the usual answer is "yes, here's how": a secure path to the outcome, not the request at face value.

What You'll Do

  • Build the secure foundation for AI at Compa. Design and implement the architecture AI tools and agents run on, across identity, data, endpoint, SaaS, and network, as reusable infrastructure. Codify it in policy, standards, and reference architectures so new tools land on a paved road, not a one-off review.

  • Make secure adoption the fast path. Help every team get on approved AI tools quickly.

  • Own requests end to end. Turn ambiguous asks into clear requirements, then design, implement, and support the solution in production, partnering with IT, engineering, legal, privacy, and business leaders along the way.

  • Secure non-human identities and agent access. Define how agents, service accounts, and integrations authenticate and what they can do, with scoped credentials, OAuth scope governance, least privilege, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for consequential actions.

  • Control the paths data takes. Govern how internal data reaches models and agents and how it leaves, through classification, permission-aware retrieval, AI gateways with DLP, MCP and tool allowlisting, and egress controls. Assess third-party models and AI vendors for security, data retention, and training-use terms.

  • Evaluate with an attacker's mindset. Map attack paths for new models, agents, and integrations, from prompt injection and unsafe tool use to OAuth abuse and data exfiltration. Decide deliberately where to add friction or say no, and document the residual risk.

  • Build for detection and response. Make sure what you build produces audit logs of prompts, tool calls, and agent actions, plus detections for anomalous tool use and unexpected data movement. Automate enforcement so secure configurations scale with the business and stay the default.

  • Raise Compa's security posture across the board. Contribute to multidisciplinary security initiatives across identity, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, network, detection, and incident response.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant hands-on security engineering experience with strong fundamentals and a security and privacy-first approach.

  • Experience designing, building, or securing AI systems or integrations, such as agents and tool use, retrieval over internal data, or MCP, and a working understanding of how they're attacked, including prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency.

  • Deep experience with identity and access architecture: SSO and federation (SAML, OIDC), conditional access and MFA, privileged access, identity lifecycle, non-human identities, and OAuth consent and scopes.

  • Hands-on experience securing endpoints and SaaS, including device management across major operating systems, device posture in access decisions, SaaS admin controls, third-party integrations, and audit logging.

  • Strong cloud and network security fundamentals, such as cloud IAM, segmentation, and egress control.

  • A working understanding of adversary TTPs and attack paths across identity, endpoint, cloud, and SaaS.

  • A builder's habits: you make the secure way the default instead of asking people to follow instructions. You'd push an MDM policy rather than send a how-to, reach for code to automate what repeats, and keep things like configurations and agent skills versioned in a repo.

  • Demonstrated staff-level judgment: reasoning from requirements to architecture before tools, turning novel problems into concrete plans, and explaining trade-offs and residual risk effectively to technical and non-technical audiences across levels.

As a Plus

  • Hands-on experience deploying AI security controls such as MCP gateways, LLM proxies, or sandboxed agent execution.

  • A background in threat hunting, incident response, detection engineering, or offensive or purple team work.

  • Familiarity with AI risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, or NIST AI RMF.

  • Experience in regulated or high-trust environments, or with privacy and data protection programs.

  • Experience building enterprise security architecture at a growing company.

Compa offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, PTO and parental leave, equity, company offsites, continuous education, commuter benefits and a flexible work environment.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Compa

Compa is a venture-backed AI startup revolutionizing the future of compensation! We're bringing AI-forward tools and human-centered engineering to make pay competitive and fair, for all. By offering a premier, live compensation data platform that delivers top-tier intelligence to enterprise teams, we enable the world's largest companies to make smart and fair decisions while staying competitive and compliant. In dynamic job markets during the rise of AI, companies need the best data to stay competitive!

Our force-multiplying team is powered by live data and thoughtful design, and our products have earned the trust of the world’s largest companies: NVIDIA, Stripe, DoorDash, OpenAI, Moderna, Workday, Ulta, Target, and more.

Come build with us!

The Role

As Enablement Lead, you will build the training program that turns every new and tenured seller into a world-class one: faster ramp, stronger skills, and a shared way of selling.

You will own onboarding, ongoing development, and certification, and build the manager capability that makes it stick. You will partner with sales leaders on a training roadmap for a fast-growing, AI-first go-to-market, and keep raising the bar on what good looks like.

Our product is increasingly AI-driven, including our AI agents layer, so this role is central to making sure every seller can explain that value with fluency and conviction as new capabilities ship. Success shows up in ramp time, win rate, pipeline quality, and forecast accuracy.

What You’ll Do

Onboarding and new-hire ramp

  • Own the onboarding plan from day one through full quota, with clear milestones and certification before a rep carries a full number.

  • Design curriculum that covers market, competition, company, product, value proposition, sales process, methodology, tools, and skills.

  • Deliver through formats that work: online, classroom, peer group, flipped-classroom, and role-play.

  • Help run the annual sales kickoff and mid-year summit as training events, not announcements.

Ongoing skills development and certification

  • Build a continuous training calendar for Sales, Customer Success and Insights teams: discovery, business case and ROI, multi-threading, security and procurement, negotiation, and expansion.

  • Certify sellers on the skills that matter, using role-plays and call-recording reviews as the assessment, not just course completion.

  • Teach account planning for the largest enterprise accounts.

  • Use pipeline review themes and call reviews to decide what to teach next.

  • Leverage AI to deliver ongoing innovation and efficiencies for the organization.

Manager and leader development

  • Teach front-line managers to coach: deal inspection, call review, and feedback using a shared scorecard.

  • Certify managers on the methodology first, so they can reinforce what reps learn.

  • Turn the forecast and pipeline review cadence into ongoing manager training.

Sales methodology

  • Own the sales methodology as the one way the team qualifies, advances, and inspects deals, with a clear "why now" for every opportunity.

  • Build the methodology into stage exit criteria instead of running it as a separate system. Gate stage advancement on the smallest set of elements that matter, and score the rest without blocking.

  • Create an evidence-based deal scorecard for inspection, coaching, and pipeline rollups.

Pipeline management and forecasting

  • Teach the pipeline standards: what counts as real pipeline, stage definitions, aging, and CRM hygiene, in partnership with RevOps.

  • Teach managers to forecast from deal evidence instead of rep confidence, with clear category definitions and a roll-up cadence.

  • Track forecast accuracy by rep, manager, and segment, and turn the gaps into coaching and training.

AI product fluency

  • Build and own the training strategy for our AI-driven roadmap, so sellers clearly and confidently articulate the value of the AI agents layer.

  • Keep messaging, positioning, and competitive differentiation in training current with Product Marketing and Product as capabilities ship.

  • Champion the use of AI-powered selling tools across the sales org, from call analysis and coaching to prospecting and deal intelligence, and partner with RevOps to ensure they're adopted and delivering measurable results.

Playbooks and in-the-moment support

  • Leveraging AI to build playbooks, battlecards, and objection handling that reinforce what is taught, and keep them in the flow of work (CRM, chat, conversation intelligence).

  • Keep them current and trusted, so a rep finds the answer in seconds, not in a course.

Measuring what works

  • Measure program effectiveness through new-hire ramp, certification results, skill assessments, participant and leader feedback, and retention.

Who you'll work with

You report to the Chief Revenue Officer and partner closely with:

  • Sales leaders and front-line managers, who reinforce everything you build.

  • Revenue operations, on stage definitions, CRM hygiene, and forecast tooling.

  • Product marketing, on messaging, battlecards, and launch enablement as new AI capabilities ship.

  • Customer success, on handoffs, expansion plays, and renewal playbooks.

  • Product, security, and legal, on the technical and compliance answers reps need mid-deal.

What We’re Looking For

Minimum

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years designing, developing, and delivering sales training, including leading a team or building the function from scratch.

  • Experience running onboarding and certification programs that shortened ramp time.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a similar methodology, with a record of embedding it in stage criteria and coaching, not just teaching it.

As a Plus

  • 5+ years in B2B sales, sales leadership, or sales enablement, including software sales.

  • Experience building manager coaching programs and designing forecast and pipeline review processes.

  • Experience building AI tools to accelerate AE performance

  • Ability to build and facilitate online, classroom, peer group, flipped-classroom, and role-play training.

  • Fluency with an LMS, HubSpot or a comparable CRM, and conversation intelligence tools, plus comfort using data to decide what to teach.

  • Experience selling or enabling complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with security and procurement review.

  • A strong facilitator and coach who earns credibility with senior reps and front-line managers.

  • Clear, concise writing: you can turn a messy deal into a one-page playbook.

  • Sound judgment on what belongs in a program versus what belongs in the flow of work.

Compa offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, PTO and parental leave, equity, company offsites, continuous education, commuter benefits and a flexible work environment.
